references.text: Both verses confirm the universal death sentence over Adam's offspring through an identical concluding formula.
Highlights that even the salvation figure Noah is subject to the same mortality as the rest of humanity.
Enosh's death confirms that all of Adam's descendants share the same fate as Adam himself.
Enosh's death contrasts with Enoch's removal and emphasizes the exception of the one who walked with God.
Confirms that death is the common lot for everyone in the genealogy, even those with long lifespans.
Lamech's death confirms the unaltered fate of humanity just before the flood.
